title.narrative: National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence (NICE)- International

description.narrative: This activity National Institute for Health and Clinical Excellence (NICE)- International is a component of Improving countries’ health financing systems to accelerate progress towards universal health coverage reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £850,321. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Health policy and administrative management.
